notes: Generated (issue 999 step 2). OnValid is pk-record-save (raised once pk-form found the form valid); OnCancel and OnDelete are pk-record-cancel and pk-record-delete, and a callback that is set shows its button (the generator's shows option sets cancellable and deletable). ChildContent is your own <form> with its fields: the element no longer draws one. With ActionsInHeader put your own Save button in the page header and have it call SubmitAsync() on an @ref to the component (it replaces the old HeaderActions).
